gloss: to shake, to rock, to undermine

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {揺|ゆ}るがしていませんでした

definitions.explanation: To cause something to shake or sway physically.

definitions.gloss: to undermine, to destabilize, to threaten
definitions.explanation: To shake the foundations of something figuratively — to threaten the stability of a system, belief, position, or relationship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{揺|ゆ}るがした。
⟦{強風|きょうふう}→強風：15269_kyoufuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{揺|ゆ}るがして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The strong wind is rattling the windows.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{爆発音|ばくはつおん}→爆発音：28327_bakuhatsuon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{揺|ゆ}るがした。
examples.english: A large explosion shook the entire town.

examples.japanese: ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{揺|ゆ}るがす⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧だ。
examples.english: It is an incident that shakes trust.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{政権|せいけん}→政権：12883_seiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基盤|きばん}→基盤：00220_kiban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{揺|ゆ}るがしかねない。
examples.english: This problem could undermine the foundations of the government.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{揺|ゆ}るがすような{大|おお}⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}び{込|こ}んで→飛び込む：04614_tobikomu⟧きた。
examples.english: Huge news that could shake the world came in.

notes:
USAGE:
The transitive counterpart of ⟦{揺|ゆ}るぐ→揺るぐ：19581_yurugu⟧ (to shake, to be shaken — intransitive). Sense 2 (figurative undermining) is more common than sense 1 in news and written contexts. Often used with ⟦{基盤|きばん}→基盤：00220_kiban⟧ (foundations), ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧ (trust), or ⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧ (system) as the object.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{揺|ゆ}るがす: to shake trust
- ⟦{基盤|きばん}→基盤：00220_kiban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{揺|ゆ}るがす: to undermine the foundations
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{揺|ゆ}るがす: to shake the world
- ⟦{根底|こんてい}→根底：13115_kontei⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{揺|ゆ}るがす: to shake from the very bottom

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{揺|ゆ}るぐ→揺るぐ：19581_yurugu⟧: to shake, to waver (intransitive)
- ⟦{揺|ゆ}らす→揺らす：02479_yurasu⟧: to shake, to swing (transitive, more gentle motion)
- ⟦{揺|ゆ}れる→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧: to sway, to shake (intransitive, general)
